capabilities: Highlight invisible or unusual Unicode characters in the editor
Flag mixed and malformed list indentation and duplicate or missing list markers
Fix flagged characters by clicking gutter icons or running a fix-all command
Enforce optional list punctuation and line-ending policies
Optionally replace typographic punctuation such as curly quotes and dashes
disambiguation: Not a spelling or grammar checker; it only flags invisible characters, indentation, and list-structure problems.
extras: The manifest carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Most fixing rules are disabled by default and require opt-in.
problem: Invisible Unicode characters (zero-width spaces, bidirectional controls, non-breaking spaces) and malformed list indentation are not visible in the editor but can break Markdown parsing, search, and diffs.

relations.evidence: inspired by Gremlins tracker for Visual Studio Code, released under the MIT License by Nicolas Hoizey
relations.plugin: Gremlins tracker for Visual Studio Code

summary: Character and Markdown hygiene linter that reveals invisible or unusual Unicode characters and malformed list formatting, with one-click or command fixes.
